name: MAGIC
full_name: Major Atmospheric Gamma Imaging Cherenkov Telescopes
summary: Gamma-ray experiment comprising two large Cherenkov telescopes; dark-matter searches are one part of its multipurpose science program.
detection_principle: Two telescopes stereoscopically image atmospheric showers, using spectra and sky distributions to test possible dark-matter radiation from dwarf galaxies, galaxy clusters and other targets.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
